passes.note: first final pass: two majors reopened as M5.39 and M5.40
second pass, fresh reviewer: F1 and F2 resolved in code; F8-F10 minor

findings.detail: The connector view drew only markers.start and markers.end; markers.mid (FR-CON-003, schema Markers.mid) was never drawn, and the gallery leg counted mid markers toward 'every marker'.
findings.failure_scenario: A document with markers.mid renders without it; a gallery edit moving a marker to mid keeps the leg green.

findings.area: standards drift / gate honesty (testing.md rule 8, non-negotiable 2)
findings.detail: testing.md rule 8 said check-drift gates re-recorded goldens and screenshots; it did not, and M5.13, M5.20 and M5.21 re-recorded render goldens without a trailer.
findings.failure_scenario: A later commit re-records a baseline to hide a regression and every gate passes.

findings.detail: Grow-on-edit is a write the M7 text-edit command applies; M7.md had no row and the roadmap no Deferred entry.
findings.failure_scenario: M7 builds inline text editing without applying fitShapeText's height; textFit grow stays a stored field no code acts on.

findings.detail: M5 used ADR-0017 to 0019; the M6 to M9 plans still cite those numbers for other decisions.
findings.failure_scenario: An m6 ADR leg matching the number prefix passes on the existing ADR-0017 before the editor-interaction ADR exists.

findings.detail: The packs/basic coverage leg is near-vacuous for a data pack; the FR-CON-012 property's reparent edits are route-neutral because members are stored in screen coordinates.
findings.failure_scenario: An unexercised pack shape passes the coverage leg; a future parent-relative transform change is not caught by the property.

findings.detail: routeConnector checks that a router path starts at the source but not that it ends at the target; curved.ts duplicates geometry helpers and render has two rounding helpers; routers live in RenderRegistries while core's routers registry stays unknown and unused.
findings.failure_scenario: A plugin router ending off the target draws a detached connector; a pack registering a router in core's registry is never used.

findings.detail: 24 task commits landed after cp1 with no further checkpoint; the backlog header said 28 planned rows while the table held 38.
findings.failure_scenario: Cross-commit drift (F1, F2) goes unseen until the final review.

findings.detail: check-drift decides whether CI judges a commit by finding 'function baselineChanges()' in the parent's check-drift source; renaming it would stop CI judging later commits, though the M5.40 harness case's --commit assertion would fail first.
findings.failure_scenario: A rename plus a removed harness assertion; check-tests-kept demands a Removes-test trailer, so not silently.

findings.detail: The first pass's hand-offs and argued items had not landed anywhere yet, and m5-complete checks only that the final review file exists.
findings.failure_scenario: M5.27 records the verdict and advances the roadmap without the hand-off rows.

findings.detail: The two-rects-line screenshots kept the pre-M5.20 arrow within maxDiffPixelRatio 0.001; the SVG goldens caught the change, as testing.md rule 15 intends.
findings.failure_scenario: A pixel-only marker regression the SVG golden cannot see passes a small fixture's screenshot.
